Text Stroke Generator

Style outlined text with -webkit-text-stroke — width, stroke and fill colors, live preview and CSS.

📖 How to use

  1. Type your text and set the font size.
  2. Choose stroke width, stroke color and fill color (or transparent fill).
  3. Preview the outlined text live.
  4. Copy the CSS or download it as text-stroke.css.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does text-stroke work in all browsers?

-webkit-text-stroke works in Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox and Opera. The generator also sets paint-order for cleaner edges.

What does transparent fill do?

The letters become hollow outlines — only the stroke is visible.

Can I use a custom font?

Yes — add your own font-family to the rule after copying it.

Why does the preview differ from my site?

Stroke rendering follows the font in use; the CSS values stay identical across fonts.
